title: Northgate Optical Frame Inventory Policy: Restocking Deduction on Returned Frames
content:
When a Northgate Optical frame goes back to stock from an in-lab cancellation, a restocking deduction may be kept out of its refund, depending on the frame's price.

**Policy.** Where the frame charge is 150.00 or more, a frame restocking deduction of the frame restocking percentage of the net frame charge is kept; where the frame charge is at least 75.00 but less than 150.00, a flat frame restocking deduction of 12.00 is kept. Where the frame charge is below 75.00, nothing is kept as a restocking deduction and the net frame charge is refunded in full.

**Two different figures.** The price band is decided by the frame charge itself — the frame charge of the original order as posted. The percentage is then applied to the net frame charge — the frame charge less every credit already posted against it.

| Frame charge as posted | Frame restocking deduction |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | the frame restocking percentage of the net frame charge |
| 75.00 up to but not including 150.00 | 12.00 |
| below 75.00 | nothing |

## Applications (hypothetical frames)

| Frame charge | Credits against it | Net | Band | Deduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 180.00 | VSP allowance 130.00 | 50.00 | 150.00 or more | the frame restocking percentage of 50.00 |
| 150.00 | none | 150.00 | 150.00 or more | the frame restocking percentage of 150.00 |
| 149.99 | none | 149.99 | 75.00 to below 150.00 | 12.00 |
| 75.00 | EyeMed allowance 75.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 to below 150.00 | 12.00 |
| 74.99 | none | 74.99 | below 75.00 | nothing |
